usage: 「淺黃色」 means 'light yellow' and is used to describe a pale or light shade of yellow.
It is most commonly used before a noun to describe the colour of something, for example: 淺黃色裙 (light yellow skirt) or 淺黃色花 (light yellow flower).
It can also be used after 「係」 to state the colour of something, for example: 件衫係淺黃色。('The shirt is light yellow.')
In everyday Cantonese, this word is useful for describing the colour of clothes, bags, walls, flowers, or light.
